topic.short: Before landing in Japan, save your hotel address in Japanese offline.
topic.body:
Your hotel address is useful only if you can open it.

Before landing, save the hotel name and address in Japanese, booking reference, check-in window and late-arrival contact together offline. Try opening the note with your connection off before departure.

The reel shows a quick checklist. Our free 12-page PDF preview lets you try the actual guide format. Which arrival detail would you want ready?
